name: dundu-planning
description: Dundu Planning -- business setup, purchase and ops tracker (MERN).

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: cd server && npm install && npm run start
